name: Tour Earnings Report
purpose: Compares how much each artist's concert tours earned, in total and per concert

inputs.artist_name: Name of the performer who headlined the tour
inputs.box_office_total: Total ticket money the tour made, in the dollars of the years it ran (not corrected for inflation)
inputs.inflation_corrected_total: Total ticket money the tour made, converted to 2022 prices
inputs.concert_count: Number of concerts played on the tour
inputs.earnings_per_concert: Average ticket money made at each concert
inputs.years_active: Year or years the tour ran
inputs.list_position: Where the tour currently sits in this list of highest-earning tours
inputs.average_ticket_price: Average price of a single ticket
inputs.total_attendance: Total number of people who attended the tour
